# Expressions

Expressions are values you put into effects and conditions. 161 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Add to world border size {#z6_border_change}

```carve
add %number% to [the] world border size [of %world%]
remove %number% from [the] world border size [of %world%]
```

Makes the world border bigger or smaller by an amount (at once).

```carve
add 10 to world border size
remove 30 from world border size
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [quaternions-protocol](../syntax/quaternions-protocol.md)

## Age of a block {#statelist_age}

```carve
[the] [max[imum]] age of %block%
```

The age of a block that has one (crops, nether wart, ...), and its maximum. Can be set, added to, removed from and reset to 0, clamped to the maximum. Blocks only; entities are not supported yet.

```carve
add 1 to age of block at location(0, 64, 0)
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-state-lists](../syntax/block-state-lists.md)

## Ago / later {#ago}

```carve
%timespan% ago
%timespan% later
time since %date%
time until %date%
```

A date relative to now, or the time since or until a date.

```carve
if time since {last::%uuid of player%} < 30 seconds:
    send "slow down" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [timespans](../syntax/timespans.md)

## All banned players/IPs {#mobitem_banned}

Banned players (online or not) or banned IP addresses as text.

```carve

    send "%loop-value%"
```

## All values of a type {#c6_sets}

```carve

```

Every value of a named-value type, like `all difficulties` or `all boss bar styles`. Works in `loop`.

```carve

    send "%loop-value%"
```

## Anvil text input / repair cost {#mobitem_anvil}

```carve

anvil [item] repair cost
```

In `on anvil prepare`: the rename text and the repair cost (Pumpkin always sends 1).

```carve

    send "%anvil text input%" to player
```

## Any of {#mobitem_any_of_expr}

```carve
(any [one]|one) of [the] %objects%
```

The items of a list. In `is` checks it means "one of".

```carve
set {_l::*} to 1, 2 and 3
send "%any of {_l::*}%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions-mobs-items](../syntax/conditions-mobs-items.md)

## Applied enchantments {#mobitem_applied}

```carve
applied (enchantments|enchants)
```

In `on enchant`: the enchantments the table adds, like `sharpness 3`. Read only.

```carve

    send "%applied enchantments%" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [conditions-mobs-items](../syntax/conditions-mobs-items.md)

## Argument {#arg}

```carve
arg[ument]
arg-%number%
```

A command argument, counted from 1. Its type comes from the command line.

```carve
command /pay <player> <number>:
    trigger:
        send "Paying %arg-2% to %arg-1%"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Arithmetic {#math}

```carve
%number% (+|-|*|/) %number%
-%number%
(%number%)
```

Math with the usual order. Works on timespans and dates too. Dividing by zero is a runtime error.

```carve
set {_half} to (5 + 3) / 2
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Banner pattern item {#statelist_banner_item}

```carve
[the] banner pattern item of %text%
```

The loom item for a banner pattern type such as `creeper`, `flower`, `globe`, `mojang`, `piglin`, `skull`, `flow`, `guster`, `field_masoned` or `bordure_indented`. Gives none for patterns that have no item.

```carve
give 1 of banner pattern item of "creeper" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-state-lists](../syntax/block-state-lists.md)

```carve

```

## Beehive honey level {#statelist_honey}

```carve
[the] [max[imum]] [bee[ ]hive|bee nest] honey level of %block%
```

The honey level (0 to 5) of a beehive or bee nest block; `max` gives 5. Can be set, added to, removed from and reset (to 0); results stay between 0 and 5.

```carve
set honey level of block at location(0, 64, 0) to 5
```

## Block {#block}

```carve
block at %location%
block (below|above) %location%
block (north|south|east|west) of %location%
targeted block [of %player%]
%player%'s targeted block
```

A block position. `targeted block` looks up to 100 blocks.

```carve
set {_b} to block below player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Block data {#c6_block_data}

```carve
[the] block data of %block%
%block%'s block data
```

The block id and its state properties as a text like `oak_log[axis=y]`. Setting it places the block and its properties; properties not named keep their value.

```carve
set block data of block at location(0, 64, 0) to "oak_log[axis=x]"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [entity-block-properties](../syntax/entity-block-properties.md)

## Block sphere {#block_sphere}

```carve
[all [the]] blocks in radius %number% (of|around) %location%
[all [the]] blocks around %location% in radius %number%
```

Every block whose center is within the radius, as block locations. The radius goes up to 32.

```carve
loop blocks in radius 3 of player:
    if type of block at loop-value is stone:
        set block at loop-value to glass
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-shapes-ai](../syntax/block-shapes-ai.md)

## Block type {#block_type}

```carve
type of %block%
```

The block type as an item, like `stone`.

```carve
send "You stand on %type of block below player%." to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [blocks](../syntax/blocks.md)

## Blocks {#blocks}

```carve
[all [the]] blocks between %location% and %location%
[all [the]] blocks from %location% to %location%
[all [the]] blocks (above|below|north|south|east|west) [of] %location%
```

`between`: every block of the box (up to 262144). `from ... to`: the blocks a straight line passes through. A direction: the 100 blocks next to the location that way.

```carve
loop blocks from player to location(0, 64, 0):
    set block at loop-value to glass
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-shapes-ai](../syntax/block-shapes-ai.md)

## Book author, title and pages {#book_values}

```carve
[the] book (author|writer|publisher) of %item%
[the] (author|writer|publisher) of %item%
[the] book (title|name) of %item%
[the] [book] (pages|content) of %item%
[the] [book] page %number% of %item%
```

The author, title and pages of a written book. They work on the held item (`player's tool`) and can be set; setting them on any held item makes it carry book content.

```carve
set book title of player's tool to "Rules"
set page 1 of player's tool to "Be nice"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-shapes-ai](../syntax/block-shapes-ai.md)

## Boss bar from key {#bossbar_by_id}

```carve
(bossbar|boss bar) [with|from] (id|key) %text%
```

The id of the boss bar with that id, or none when there is no such bar. Carve names bars by their text id, so the result works anywhere a bar id does.

```carve
set {_b} to boss bar with id "raid"
if {_b} is set:
    show bossbar {_b} to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-shapes-ai](../syntax/block-shapes-ai.md)

## Chest inventory {#chest_inventory}

```carve
[a] [new] chest (inventory|gui|menu) [with %number% (row|rows)] [(named|titled|called|with name|with title) %text%]
```

A new, empty chest inventory value: 1 to 6 rows (3 when not given), titled `Chest` when not named. Keep it in a variable, fill it with `set slot`, then `open` it. Copies are the same inventory, so `event-inventory is {shop}` works.

```carve
set {_gui} to chest inventory with 3 rows named "Shop"
set slot 4 of {_gui} to diamond named "&bBuy"
open {_gui} to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [inventories](../syntax/inventories.md)

## Creature / entity / typed event entity {#event_entity_typed}


In `on damage` and `on death`: the hurt or dead mob. With a type (`the zombie`) it is none when the mob is another type. Players are `player` and `victim`.

## Damage value and durability {#item_damage_value}

```carve
[the] (damage [value]|durability) of %item%
```

How much durability an item has used up, and how much it has left. Can be set, reset, added to and removed from on the held item (`player's tool`).

```carve

send "%durability of player's tool% uses left"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-shapes-ai](../syntax/block-shapes-ai.md)

## Damage values {#damage_values}

```carve
damage
attacker
victim
```

In `on damage` and `on death`: the damage of the hit, the attacking player or entity and the hurt player or entity. `attacker is a zombie`, `type of attacker` and `name of attacker` (the custom name, else the type) work on entities.

```carve
on damage:
    if attacker is a player:
        send "%attacker% hit you for %damage%" to victim
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [triggers](../syntax/triggers.md)

## De-queue {#statelist_dequeue}

```carve

```

Removes the first value (or the first N values) from a queue variable and gives them. The variable keeps the rest. An empty queue gives none.

```carve
set {_next} to dequeue {_queue}
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [block-state-lists](../syntax/block-state-lists.md)

## Vector and quaternion components {#z6_components}


`w of q` reads the w part of a quaternion (`x`, `y`, `z` work on vectors and quaternions). `set`, `add` and `remove` change one part of a vector or quaternion variable. Yaw and pitch turn a vector (keeping its length), a player or an entity.

```carve
add 2 to y of {_v}
```
